text: Level two, question three: pipes A and B fill a tank in fifteen and ten minutes; both are opened together, but B is closed five minutes before the tank is full; find the total time. Question four: pipe A fills a tank in eight hours; when the tank is half full, an outlet that empties a full tank in twenty-four hours is also opened; find the total time to fill the tank. Question five: pipes A and B fill a tank in four and six minutes; they are opened alternately for one minute each, A first; find the time to fill the tank.
